clips.title: The story
paras: The Boar Hunter is an early errand given by the dwarf hunter Talin Keeneye in Coldridge Valley. A surge in the local crag boar population has made the woods overly dangerous, and young recruits are tasked with culling the aggressive beasts so seasoned hunters can track in peace.

Coldridge Valley is typically a quiet, protected training ground for young mountaineers and scholars of Ironforge. However, the wildlife often grows restless and overabundant in the harsh winter climate. Talin Keeneye, a veteran hunter stationed outside Anvilmar, notices that the aggressive small crag boars have multiplied so rapidly that they pose a genuine threat to anyone wandering the snow-covered trails.

Hunting is a cornerstone of dwarven life, providing meat, hide, and essential fieldcraft practice. Yet when game becomes a nuisance that attacks on sight, culling is required to restore balance. By trimming the crag boar numbers across the valley slopes, young adventurers prove their combat readiness while giving local hunters room to pursue their sport without getting overwhelmed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.
Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I can go back to my... Leisurely... Hunting now. Thank you, friend.
